trade.title: Trade with {name}
trade.usage: <#f1e2c2>Trade: <#ffcf4a>/trade <player></#ffcf4a> · answer requests with <#ffcf4a>/trade accept</#ffcf4a> or <#ffcf4a>/trade deny</#ffcf4a>.
trade.error.offline: <#ff5a4a>{name} is not in this city. Trading only works on the same instance.
trade.error.self: <#ff5a4a>You cannot trade with yourself. Find another player.
trade.error.busy-self: <#ff5a4a>You are already trading. Finish that trade first.
trade.error.busy: <#ff5a4a>{name} is trading with someone else. Try again in a moment.
trade.error.distance: <#ff5a4a>{name} is too far away. Move closer (at most {distance} blocks).
trade.error.already-requested: <#ffb43a>Note: You already asked {name}. Wait for an answer.
trade.error.no-request: <#ff5a4a>No open trade request. It may have expired.
trade.request.sent: <#f1e2c2>Trade request sent to <#ffcf4a>{name}</#ffcf4a>. It is valid for {seconds} seconds.
trade.request.received: <#ffcf4a>{name}</#ffcf4a> <#f1e2c2>wants to trade with you. <click:run_command:/trade accept {name}><hover:show_text:'Open the trade window'><#4ac85e>[Accept]</#4ac85e></hover></click> <click:run_command:/trade deny {name}><hover:show_text:'Deny the request'><#ff5a4a>[Deny]</#ff5a4a></hover></click> <#7a4a24>({seconds} s)</#7a4a24>
trade.request.denied: <#ffb43a>Note: {name} does not want to trade right now.
trade.started: <#f1e2c2>Trade with <#ffcf4a>{name}</#ffcf4a> opened. Click items in your inventory to offer them.
trade.ready.reset: <#ffb43a>Note: The offer changed – both have to press “Ready” again.
trade.cancelled.shutdown: <#ffb43a>Note: The trade was cancelled because of a restart. Your items are back.
trade.cancelled.left: <#ffb43a>Note: The trade fell through – a partner is gone. Your items are back.
trade.cancelled.distance: <#ffb43a>Note: You are standing too far apart. The trade was cancelled, your items are back.
trade.cancelled.funds: <#ff5a4a>{name} does not have enough crowns. The trade was cancelled, your items are back.
trade.cancelled.unavailable: <#ff5a4a>The bank is not answering. The trade was cancelled, your items are back.
trade.cancelled.manual: <#ffb43a>Note: {name} cancelled the trade. Your items are back.
trade.cancelled.closed: <#ffb43a>Note: {name} closed the trade window. Your items are back.
trade.cancelled.teleport: <#ffb43a>Note: {name} teleported away. The trade was cancelled, your items are back.
trade.kronen.prompt: <#f1e2c2>How many crowns do you offer? Type the number in chat (currently <#ffcf4a>{amount}</#ffcf4a>, <#ffcf4a>cancel</#ffcf4a> keeps the value).
trade.kronen.invalid: <#ff5a4a>That is not a valid number. Type for example <#ffcf4a>250</#ffcf4a>.
trade.kronen.too-much: <#ff5a4a>You do not have that many crowns. Your balance: <#ffcf4a>{balance}</#ffcf4a>.
trade.full: <#ff5a4a>All offer slots are taken. Take an item out first.
